meta.name: Triage slowing Zoho CRM deals with OpenAI GPT-4o-mini and send Slack alerts

name: Deal Momentum Tracker with Velocity Analysis and Acceleration Alerts

parameters.content:
## Fetch and Prepare Deal Data
This section triggers the workflow on a schedule, retrieves active deals from the CRM, and splits them into individual records. It ensures each deal is processed independently, enabling accurate analysis and downstream automation for every opportunity.

## Analyze Deal Momentum and Identify Risks
This section calculates key performance metrics like velocity, activity frequency, and momentum score. It filters out slowing deals and uses AI to generate actionable recommendations, helping identify at-risk opportunities that need immediate attention.

## Combine AI Insights and Format Alerts
This section merges AI-generated recommendations with deal data and formats them into a structured alert message. It transforms raw insights into a clear, readable format that sales teams can quickly understand and act upon.

## Prepare and Send Notifications
This section prepares the final alert payload and sends it to the sales team via Slack. It ensures timely delivery of actionable insights so the team can respond quickly and re-engage deals that are losing momentum.

## How Workflow Works

- The workflow starts on a scheduled interval (every 2 hours) to continuously monitor deal activity without manual effort.
- It fetches all active deals from Zoho CRM and splits them into individual items so each deal can be processed independently.
- For every deal, momentum metrics are calculated using recent activity data, including velocity, frequency, and recency.
- Deals showing signs of slowdown are filtered based on declining velocity and low engagement signals.
- These filtered deals are sent to an AI model, which analyzes the situation and generates recommended tactics, priority level, and reasoning.
- The AI output is merged back with the original deal data to maintain full context.
- A formatted alert message is created, combining deal insights and AI recommendations into a readable structure.
- Finally, the alert is sent to the sales team via Slack, enabling quick action on at-risk deals.



## Setup Steps

- Connect your Zoho CRM account in n8n and configure the Get Active Deals node to fetch deal data, including activities.
- Set up the Schedule Trigger node to define how frequently the workflow should run (e.g., every 2 hours).
- Ensure your deal data includes activity history (calls, emails, meetings) required for momentum calculation.
- Configure the AI node with an OpenAI (or similar) API key and set the prompt to return structured JSON output.
- Use a Merge node in “Combine by Position” mode to correctly align AI output with corresponding deals.
- Add the Code node to parse AI output and format the alert message properly.
- Connect your Slack account and select the appropriate channel in the Send Alert node.
- Test the workflow with sample data to verify outputs, then activate it for continuous automated monitoring.
